what_it_does: Addresses routing (connecting circuit components) under Triple Patterning Lithography (TPL—a manufacturing technique that prints circuits using three separate photomasks to achieve finer feature sizes). When a net (electrical connection) spans multiple pins, assigning colors to those pins becomes a complex constraint satisfaction problem. Existing methods struggle with multi-pin nets, creating excessive conflicts and stitches (discontinuities). Mr.TPL introduces novel color assignment and stitch-reduction algorithms optimized for multi-pin routing.
